english: Welcome, [CT_NAME]. I am [OUR_NAME], ruler of all of [OUR_CIV_SHORT]. You will find me a fair man to deal with - cruel, but fair.
chinese: 欢迎，[CT_NAME]。我是[OUR_NAME]，[OUR_CIV_SHORT]全境的统治者。你会发现我是个公道的谈判对象——残忍，但公道。

english: Well hello there, [CT_NAME]. It is a pleasure to meet you at last! I'm always looking for CLOSER relations with other leaders, if you get my drift...
chinese: 哎呀，你好呀，[CT_NAME]。终于见到你了，真是荣幸！我可一向乐意跟别的领袖建立更“亲密”的关系，你懂我的意思吧……

english: Her most righteous majesty, Isabella, beloved of God and protector of the faith, does condescend to greet you, [CT_NAME]. Do tell me: are you a righteous people, or are you fiendish heathens who need to be wiped off of the face of this fair land?
chinese: 至圣至明的女王伊莎贝拉，蒙神眷爱、信仰的守护者，屈尊向你致意，[CT_NAME]。且告诉我：你们是正义之民，还是该从这片美好土地上被彻底抹去的邪恶异教徒？

english: Stop pestering me!
chinese: 别再来烦我了！

english: I have nothing to say to you.
chinese: 我跟你没什么好说的。

english: Sorry, [CT_NAME], talk does not interest us!
chinese: 抱歉，[CT_NAME]，谈话我们没兴趣！

english: Go away. We have nothing to discuss.
chinese: 走开。我们没什么好谈的。

english: Leave me alone!
chinese: 别来烦我！

english: I am not interested in hearing any more of your lies. Go away.
chinese: 我不想再听你的谎话了。走开。

english: [OUR_EMPIRE] does not negotiate with terrorists.
chinese: [OUR_EMPIRE]绝不与恐怖分子谈判。

english: We shall not listen to your insidious lies. Begone!
chinese: 我们不会听你那阴险的谎言。滚吧！

english: Your words are but the braying of a jackass, [CT_NAME]. Take them elsewhere.
chinese: 你的话不过是蠢驴的嘶鸣，[CT_NAME]。拿到别处去说吧。

english: Talk to the ceremonial blade, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 去跟祭祀之刃谈吧，[CT_NAME]。

english: The mere sight of you offends me, [CT_NAME]. Begone!
chinese: 光是看见你就令我不悦，[CT_NAME]。滚吧！

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] will not listen to your bourgoise lies!
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]绝不会听你那套资产阶级的谎言！

english: Begone, you lying serpent!
chinese: 滚开，你这条撒谎的毒蛇！

english: Go away you horrible little person!
chinese: 走开，你这个可憎的小人物！

english: We are not amused by your meaningless babble, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: 你那毫无意义的胡言乱语，让我们兴味索然，[CT_NAME]！

english: Forget it. I have wigs that are smarter than you are.
chinese: 算了吧。我的假发都比你聪明。

english: Talk to the massed artillery, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 去跟成排的炮兵谈吧，[CT_NAME]。

english: Speak with YOU? Do not make me laugh!
chinese: 跟你谈？别逗我笑了！

english: I have more important things to do than to exchange lies with you. Come back another day.
chinese: 我有比跟你交换谎言更要紧的事要做。改天再来吧。

english: It is a waste of time to speak with fools. Go away.
chinese: 跟蠢货说话是浪费时间。走开。

english: We will not listen to your lies, [CT_NAME]. Remove yourself from our presence.
chinese: 我们不会听你的谎话，[CT_NAME]。从我面前消失。

english: Further discussion at this point would be meaningless. Not to mention very annoying. Go away.
chinese: 此刻再谈下去毫无意义。更别提有多惹人厌了。走开。

english: I have no time to exchange pleasantries with you, [CT_NAME]: I am too busy plotting your downfall.
chinese: 我没空跟你寒暄客套，[CT_NAME]：我正忙着谋划你的覆灭呢。

english: Take your pathetic lies elsewhere, for I do not wish to hear them.
chinese: 把你那可悲的谎话拿到别处去，我不愿听。

english: Bah! This chatter is a waste of time! Begone!
chinese: 呸！这种废话是浪费时间！滚吧！

english: Hello, this is [OUR_NAME]. [OUR_CIV_SHORT] is not at home right now: please leave your name and number and we'll get back to you when pigs have wings.
chinese: 你好，这里是[OUR_NAME]。[OUR_CIV_SHORT]现在不在家：请留下姓名和电话，等母猪上树那天我们再回你。

english: Vile serpent! [OUR_CIV_SHORT] will not listen to your lies!
chinese: 卑鄙的毒蛇！[OUR_CIV_SHORT]绝不会听你的谎言！

english: Negotiate this, pal!
chinese: 有本事谈谈这个吧，老兄！

english: Guards! Toss this villain out into the snow before I commit a diplomatic incident!
chinese: 卫兵！在我闹出外交事件之前，把这恶棍扔到雪地里去！

english: I find you strangely unattractive, [CT_NAME]. Do not return until you are better-looking.
chinese: 我怎么就是觉得你不好看呢，[CT_NAME]。等你长得顺眼些再来吧。

english: Your lying words pollute the heavens, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: 你那撒谎的言辞污染了天堂，[CT_NAME]！

english: We look forward to many years of peace between the [OUR_CIV_ADJ] and [CT_CIV_ADJ] Empires.
chinese: 我们期盼[OUR_CIV_ADJ]与[CT_CIV_ADJ]两大帝国之间迎来多年的和平。

english: May the peace be eternal.
chinese: 愿和平永存。

english: May we all live long and prosper.
chinese: 愿我们都长命百岁、繁荣昌盛。

english: May this peace last until there is no more room to expand!
chinese: 愿这份和平延续到再无扩张之地为止！

english: I look forward to years of peace with you, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 我期盼与你共度多年的和平，[CT_NAME]。

english: Wonderful!
chinese: 太好了！

english: [CT_NAME], let us sit in a circle and sing "Kumbaya" to celebrate this great event!
chinese: [CT_NAME]，让我们围坐成圈，唱一曲《Kumbaya》来庆祝这一盛事吧！

english: Minions! Prepare a feast to celebrate the peace between our great Empires!
chinese: 侍从们！备下盛宴，庆祝我们两大帝国之间的和平！

english: You have our gratitude.
chinese: 承蒙你的美意。

english: May the peace last a thousand years.
chinese: 愿这份和平延续千年。

english: There is no way to peace. Peace is the way.
chinese: 通往和平没有别的路。和平本身即是路。

english: You have chosen wisely.
chinese: 你的选择很明智。

english: Excellent!
chinese: 好极了！

english: I applaud your wisdom.
chinese: 我为你的智慧喝彩。

english: Wonderful.
chinese: 太好了。

english: Excellent! Now let us join together and destroy somebody else!
chinese: 好极了！现在让我们联手，去毁灭别的什么人吧！

english: You are wiser than you appear, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 你比看上去要聪明，[CT_NAME]。

english: Peace with honor, [CT_NAME]: that's what it's all about.
chinese: 光荣的和平，[CT_NAME]：这才是最重要的。

english: You are not as foolish as you first appear, [CT_NAME]. I am pleased.
chinese: 你并不像初见时那般愚蠢，[CT_NAME]。我很满意。

english: May the peace last until there is no one else to conquer!
chinese: 愿这份和平延续到再无他人可征服为止！

english: No way.
chinese: 没门。

english: Not until every last [CT_CIV_ADJ] warrior is ground into dust!
chinese: 除非每一个[CT_CIV_ADJ]战士都化为尘土！

english: Never!
chinese: 绝不！

english: There will be no peace, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 不会有和平的，[CT_NAME]。

english: Peace? Hah! Forget it.
chinese: 和平？哈！休想。

english: It is much too late for that, [CT_NAME]. Take your punishment like a man!
chinese: 太迟了，[CT_NAME]。像个男子汉一样受罚吧！

english: Certainly not! You've awoken a sleeping tiger, [CT_NAME], and I hope you choke on it.
chinese: 当然不行！你惊醒了一只沉睡的猛虎，[CT_NAME]，但愿它把你活活噎死。

english: America does not negotiate with terrorists.
chinese: 美利坚绝不与恐怖分子谈判。

english: Never! You are an enemy of God! Prepare for thy doom!
chinese: 绝不！你是神的敌人！准备迎接你的末日吧！

english: No. We have not yet sacrificed enough [CT_CIV_ADJ] warriors to slake the gods' unending thirst for blood. Try back later.
chinese: 不。我们献祭的[CT_CIV_ADJ]战士还不够多，尚未满足诸神对鲜血无尽的渴求。晚些再来吧。

english: No. You have not yet learned the proper respect for your betters.
chinese: 不。你还没学会对尊长应有的敬意。

english: There can never be peace in the unending war between the people and the bloodsucking bourgoise capitalist opressors who seek to enslave them! That would be you, punk.
chinese: 在人民与妄图奴役他们的吸血资本主义资产阶级压迫者之间那场无尽的战争里，永远不会有和平！那说的就是你，废物。

english: Gods do not negitiate with mortals - particularly with ugly little slimeballs such as yourself. Go back to your home to await your doom.
chinese: 神明不与凡人谈判——尤其是像你这样丑陋的小烂泥。滚回家去等死吧。

english: Do you plead for mercy, [CT_NAME]? You'll find none here - only justice!
chinese: 你是在乞求宽恕吗，[CT_NAME]？这里没有宽恕——只有公道！

english: War is deeply unpleasant, but sometimes necessary. We're told that this is one of those times, so we must refuse your pleas. This interview is concluded.
chinese: 战争令人深恶痛绝，但有时在所难免。我们得到禀报，此刻正是这种时候，因此我们必须拒绝你的求和。此次会谈到此为止。

english: It is far too late for peace, you silly [CT_CIV_ADJ] person! Now go away or I shall taunt you a second time!
chinese: 求和早就太迟了，你这愚蠢的[CT_CIV_ADJ]人！现在走开，否则我要再嘲弄你一次！

english: Why should I agree to peace when my [OUR_CIV_ADJ] armies are making such short work of you?
chinese: 我的[OUR_CIV_ADJ]大军正把你打得如此不堪一击，我凭什么要答应和平？

english: Your request is denied. Welcome to total war, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 你的请求被驳回。欢迎迎接全面战争，[CT_NAME]。

english: Your continued existence is an insult to the mighty [OUR_EMPIRE]. This war shall end when you have been erased from the planet.
chinese: 你还活着，本身就是对伟大[OUR_EMPIRE]的侮辱。这场战争，要等到你从这颗星球上被抹去时才会结束。

english: You may beg and plead all you like, [CT_NAME], but it will do you no good. The war will continue until the gods grow tired of it.
chinese: 你尽可以乞求哀告，[CT_NAME]，但那毫无用处。战争会持续下去，直到诸神厌倦为止。

english: There shall be no true peace in the world until you are no longer in it. The war continues.
chinese: 只要你还活在世上，世间就不会有真正的和平。战争继续。

english: I may be a pacifist, [CT_NAME], but I'm not an idiot. [OUR_CIV_SHORT] declines your request.
chinese: 我或许是个和平主义者，[CT_NAME]，但我不是傻子。[OUR_CIV_SHORT]拒绝你的请求。

english: What? Leave you alive to betray and backstab us again?! I shall not sleep easily until you are totally vanquished!
chinese: 什么？留你活命，好让你再次背叛、暗算我们？！不把你彻底击垮，我睡不安稳！

english: Your nation pollutes the very world with its corruption, [CT_NAME]. You must be exterminated.
chinese: 你的国度以其腐败玷污了整个世界，[CT_NAME]。你必须被铲除。

english: Now? While everybody's having so much fun? I don't think so!
chinese: 现在？大家正玩得尽兴的时候？我看不行！

english: No! [OUR_CIV_ADJ] laws demand that you be further punished for your insolence!
chinese: 不！[OUR_CIV_ADJ]的律法要求，你须为你的傲慢受到进一步的惩罚！

english: You have yet to pay fully for your sins, [CT_NAME]. Your people's sufferings will continue until you have done so.
chinese: 你还没为你的罪孽付清代价，[CT_NAME]。你的子民会继续受苦，直到你偿清为止。

english: I have a better idea - how about I just raze your cities and sow your fields with salt?
chinese: 我有个更好的主意——不如我把你的城市夷为平地，再往你的田里撒盐，如何？

english: Mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT] does not negotiate with the likes of you! Now go before I have my Cossacks hack you to bits!
chinese: 强盛的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]绝不与你这种货色谈判！趁我还没让哥萨克把你剁成碎块，快滚！

english: I must refuse, [CT_NAME]; peace is not in our best interests at this time. Besides, I think that men in uniform look totally yummy, don't you?
chinese: 我只能拒绝了，[CT_NAME]；此时的和平不符合我们的利益。再说，我觉得穿制服的男人看着可真诱人，你说是不是？

english: No! God commands that I continue this holy crusade until I have achieved total victory! Begone, churl!
chinese: 不！神命我将这场圣战进行到彻底胜利为止！滚开，贱民！

english: Hello, [CT_NAME]. What is it that you wish to discuss?
chinese: 你好，[CT_NAME]。你想商谈些什么？

english: Greetings. What may humble [OUR_CIV_SHORT] do for the mighty [CT_CIV_SHORT]?
chinese: 你好。卑微的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]能为强盛的[CT_CIV_SHORT]效些什么劳？

english: Greetings.  How may we be of assistance?
chinese: 你好。我们有何能效劳之处？

english: Welcome, friend [CT_NAME]. How may we be of assistance?
chinese: 欢迎你，朋友[CT_NAME]。我们有何能效劳之处？

english: Hello again!
chinese: 又见面啦！

english: Good day to you, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 祝你今日安好，[CT_NAME]。

english: So what's going on?
chinese: 那么，有什么事？

english: Hello, [CT_NAME]. What can I do for you?
chinese: 你好，[CT_NAME]。我能为你做些什么？

english: What is on your mind?
chinese: 你在想些什么？

english: To what do I owe the pleasure of your company?'
chinese: 是什么风把你吹来了？

english: Greetings, [CT_NAME]; how may we be of service?
chinese: 你好，[CT_NAME]；我们有何能效劳之处？

english: Welcome, [CT_NAME], to my home.
chinese: 欢迎你，[CT_NAME]，来到我的居所。

english: Hello, [CT_NAME], leader of mighty [CT_CIV_SHORT].
chinese: 你好，[CT_NAME]，强盛的[CT_CIV_SHORT]之领袖。

english: And what brings [CT_CIV_SHORT] to my humble palace?
chinese: 是什么让[CT_CIV_SHORT]大驾光临我这寒酸的宫殿？

english: How may the [OUR_EMPIRE] assist mighty [CT_CIV_SHORT]?
chinese: [OUR_EMPIRE]能为强盛的[CT_CIV_SHORT]效些什么劳？

english: And to what do I owe the pleasure of your company?
chinese: 那么，是什么风把你吹来了？

english: Greetings, [CT_NAME]. How was your journey from the [CT_EMPIRE]? I slept there once, you know.
chinese: 你好，[CT_NAME]。从[CT_EMPIRE]一路过来，旅途还顺利吗？你知道吗，我曾在那儿睡过一晚。

english: How absolutely marvey to see you again, [CT_NAME]! Do sit down; my man will get you a Martini.
chinese: 再见到你真是妙不可言，[CT_NAME]！快请坐；我的仆人给你调杯马提尼。

english: Blessings be upon you, oh mighty [CT_NAME]! Your glorious personage bestows great honor upon my humble kingdom!
chinese: 愿福祉降临于你，噢，伟大的[CT_NAME]！您光耀的尊躯为我这卑微的王国带来了莫大荣光！

english: Welcome, friend [CT_NAME]! I will slaughter many slaves in celebration of your visit!
chinese: 欢迎你，朋友[CT_NAME]！我要宰杀众多奴隶来庆祝你的到访！

english: Greetings, [CT_NAME]! Who shall we betray and destroy today?
chinese: 你好，[CT_NAME]！今天我们要背叛并消灭谁呢？

english: On behalf of the great and glorious Communist Party of China and of all of her horrible little peasants - I mean, "glorious workers" - greetings!
chinese: 谨代表伟大光荣的中国共产党，以及她所有那些可憎的小农民——我是说，“光荣的工人”——向你问好！

english: Hello again, [CT_NAME]. How honored you must be to see me once more.
chinese: 又见面了，[CT_NAME]。能再次见到我，你该有多荣幸啊。

english: Good afternoon, [CT_NAME]. And how is that quaint little empire of yours doing?
chinese: 午安，[CT_NAME]。你那古雅的小帝国如今可还好？

english: On behalf of Mighty Britannia, we are almost pleased to grant you an audience, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 谨代表强盛的不列颠尼亚，我们几乎算是乐意赐你一次觐见，[CT_NAME]。

english: Welcome to my palace, [CT_NAME]. Care to watch me shave?
chinese: 欢迎来到我的宫殿，[CT_NAME]。想看我刮胡子吗？

english: I am quite busy today, [CT_NAME], but perhaps I can grant you a short audience.
chinese: 我今日甚是繁忙，[CT_NAME]，不过或许可以赐你一次短暂的觐见。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] salutes you, [CT_NAME]. Come - sit down and admire my huge mustaches!
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]向你致意，[CT_NAME]。来——坐下，赞叹我这两撇大胡子吧！

english: Welcome, my friend! Come, let us mount our chariots and destroy our foes, leaving fifty thousand rotting corpses upon the battlefield for the crows to fatten upon!
chinese: 欢迎你，我的朋友！来，让我们跨上战车，去消灭我们的仇敌，在战场上留下五万具腐烂的尸体，喂肥那些乌鸦！

english: I, [OUR_NAME], do welcome you, [CT_NAME], leader of the [CT_EMPIRE]. Let us speak of the slow, painful deaths of our enemies! Care for a smoked hamster?
chinese: 我，[OUR_NAME]，欢迎你，[CT_NAME]，[CT_EMPIRE]的领袖。让我们来聊聊仇敌们缓慢而痛苦的死法吧！来点熏仓鼠肉吗？

english: Greetings, fair [CT_NAME]! May our two countries live forever in peace and harmony!
chinese: 你好，善良的[CT_NAME]！愿我们两国永世和睦共处！

english: Greetings, [CT_NAME]. I trust you have come in peace?
chinese: 你好，[CT_NAME]。我相信你是为和平而来的？

english: It is good to see you again, [CT_NAME]! Let us sit down and plot the ruination of our enemies.
chinese: 很高兴又见到你，[CT_NAME]！让我们坐下，一同谋划仇敌的覆灭吧。

english: We meet again, [CT_NAME]. It is truly a blessed day for [OUR_CIV_SHORT]!
chinese: 我们又见面了，[CT_NAME]。对[OUR_CIV_SHORT]而言，这真是蒙福的一天！

english: Welcome to my yurt, [CT_NAME]! Let us sit upon these horse-hair cushions and discuss many things! Care for some boiled yak?
chinese: 欢迎来到我的毡帐，[CT_NAME]！让我们坐在这些马鬃垫子上，畅谈诸事！来点煮牦牛肉吗？

english: Welcome to China, [CT_NAME]! Let us sit upon these golden thrones and discuss many things! Care for some kung pao yak?
chinese: 欢迎来到中国，[CT_NAME]！让我们坐上这些黄金宝座，畅谈诸事！来点宫保牦牛肉吗？

english: I salute you, ruler of the [CT_EMPIRE]. May your inevitable destruction at the hands of Mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT] be long delayed!
chinese: 我向你致意，[CT_EMPIRE]的统治者。愿你终将败于强盛[OUR_CIV_SHORT]之手的那一天来得越晚越好！

english: Greetings, my friend. What may I, [OUR_NAME], Emperor of Mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT], do for your insignificant civilization today?
chinese: 你好，我的朋友。我，[OUR_NAME]，强盛[OUR_CIV_SHORT]的皇帝，今日能为你那微不足道的文明做些什么？

english: Mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT] greets you in friendship, [CT_NAME]. And in a drunken stupor too.
chinese: 强盛的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]以友谊向你致意，[CT_NAME]。顺便还带着几分醉意。

english: Welcome, [CT_NAME]. Is that a treaty in your pocket or are you just glad to see me?
chinese: 欢迎你，[CT_NAME]。你口袋里揣的是一份条约呢，还是仅仅因见到我而欢喜？

english: Her most righteous majesty, [OUR_NAME], beloved of God and protector of the faith, does condescend to greet you once more, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 至圣至明的女王，[OUR_NAME]，蒙神眷爱、信仰的守护者，屈尊再次向你致意，[CT_NAME]。

english: Well?
chinese: 怎么？

english: What is it?
chinese: 什么事？

english: Well? Get on with it!
chinese: 怎么？有话快说！

english: What do YOU want?
chinese: 你想干什么？

english: Let's hear it.
chinese: 说来听听。

english: What is it this time, [CT_NAME]?
chinese: 这次又是什么事，[CT_NAME]？

english: My time is valuable, [CT_NAME]. What do you want?
chinese: 我的时间很宝贵，[CT_NAME]。你想要什么？

english: Do not make me angry, [CT_NAME]. You wouldn't like me when I'm angry.
chinese: 别惹我发火，[CT_NAME]。我发起火来可不好看。

english: And what does puny [CT_CIV_SHORT] want from mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT]?
chinese: 渺小的[CT_CIV_SHORT]又想从强盛的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]这儿讨要什么？

english: Speak your piece, [CT_NAME] - I haven't got all day.
chinese: 有话直说，[CT_NAME]——我可没一整天工夫奉陪。

english: Are you still around? I thought somebody wiped out your puny civilization years ago.
chinese: 你还在啊？我还以为几年前就有人把你那渺小的文明给灭了呢。

english: Oh, it's you. Now my day is complete.
chinese: 哦，是你啊。我这一天可算圆满了。

english: Well, look what the cat dragged in.
chinese: 哟，瞧瞧是谁来了。

english: I studied on killin' you.
chinese: 我盘算着要杀了你。

english: You try my patience, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 你在挑战我的耐心，[CT_NAME]。

english: I'm listening.
chinese: 我听着呢。

english: What could [CT_CIV_SHORT] possibly have to say that would be of interest to [OUR_CIV_SHORT]?
chinese: [CT_CIV_SHORT]能有什么话，值得[OUR_CIV_SHORT]一听？

english: Come to add to our troubles, have you? Well, get on with it then.
chinese: 来给我们添乱的，是吧？行，那就快说吧。

english: What a surprise! I did not realize it was locust season once again.
chinese: 真是稀客！我竟没料到又到了蝗灾泛滥的季节。

english: Tell me, [CT_NAME]: what has [CT_CIV_SHORT] done to anger the gods so that they give them you as leader?
chinese: 告诉我，[CT_NAME]：[CT_CIV_SHORT]究竟做了什么触怒诸神，才落得让你来当领袖？

english: Greetings, [CT_NAME]! We are, as always, happy to see you again.
chinese: 你好，[CT_NAME]！一如既往，我们很高兴又见到你。

english: It is people like you, [CT_NAME], who give ruthless dictators a bad name. Why are you here?
chinese: 正是你这种人，[CT_NAME]，才让冷血独裁者背上了坏名声。你来这儿干什么？

english: Bow before me, [CT_NAME] - a goddess deserves no less!
chinese: 向我跪拜，[CT_NAME]——女神理应受此礼遇！

english: Well? Out with it, you tiresome little person!
chinese: 怎么？有话就说，你这烦人的小人物！

english: Good day to you, [CT_NAME]. To what do we owe this unexpected interruption?
chinese: 祝你今日安好，[CT_NAME]。这场意料之外的叨扰，所为何来？

english: Back again so soon, [CT_NAME]? How glorious. Imagine my excitement.
chinese: 这么快又回来了，[CT_NAME]？多么光荣。想象一下我有多激动吧。

english: I have little time for your prattle, [CT_NAME]. That is the long and short of it.
chinese: 我没什么工夫听你唠叨，[CT_NAME]。就这么简单。

english: Get to the point, [CT_NAME]. I have IMPORTANT matters of state to deal with.
chinese: 有话直说，[CT_NAME]。我还有重要的国事要处理。

english: Still alive, are you? How disappointing.
chinese: 还活着呢？真让人失望。

english: It is a source of unending astonishment to me that the gods permit you to live, [CT_NAME]. Why are you here?
chinese: 诸神竟容你活着，[CT_NAME]，这真令我惊诧不已。你来这儿干什么？

english: Why have you come to trouble us, [CT_NAME]?
chinese: 你为何要来烦扰我们，[CT_NAME]？

english: All people, no matter how unpleasant, are welcome in [OUR_CIV_SHORT], [CT_NAME].
chinese: 无论多么讨人厌，所有人在[OUR_CIV_SHORT]都受欢迎，[CT_NAME]。

english: Greetings, [CT_NAME]! [OUR_CIV_SHORT] is honored by your visit. You can be sure that we will be coming to your country very soon now.
chinese: 你好，[CT_NAME]！[OUR_CIV_SHORT]因你的到访而深感荣幸。你尽可放心，我们很快就会去拜访你的国家了。

english: I do not approve of you or your country, [CT_NAME]. What have you to say that will change my opinion of you?
chinese: 我并不认可你，也不认可你的国家，[CT_NAME]。你有什么话，能改变我对你的看法？

english: And they call US barbarians?
chinese: 他们竟然还管我们叫野蛮人？

english: My grandfather would have destroyed you on sight, [CT_NAME]. Alas, but I live in more "civilized" times. What do you want?
chinese: 我祖父一见到你就会把你灭了，[CT_NAME]。可惜啊，我生在更“文明”的时代。你想要什么？

english: I wonder, [CT_NAME]: how many hanging chads did it take to get YOU into office?
chinese: 我很好奇，[CT_NAME]：你是靠数了多少张废票，才混上这个位子的？

english: Why are you here? Is it the Ides of March already?
chinese: 你来这儿干什么？难道已经到三月十五了？

english: Be brief, [CT_NAME]. I'm trying to give up hacking annoying people to death in a blind rage for Lent.
chinese: 长话短说，[CT_NAME]。我正努力在四旬斋期间戒掉盛怒之下砍死烦人之徒的毛病呢。

english: Remarkable: a politician who even I won't sleep with.
chinese: 真稀奇：竟有个连我都不愿与之同床的政客。

english: I'm glad you're here, [CT_NAME]. My Grand Inquisitor would like to have a word with you.
chinese: 很高兴你来了，[CT_NAME]。我的宗教大裁判官想跟你聊几句。

english: So what do you propose?
chinese: 那么，你有何提议？

english: Make an offer.
chinese: 开个价吧。

english: Let us begin!
chinese: 咱们开始吧！

english: Hopefully we can come to an agreement.
chinese: 但愿我们能达成一致。

english: What does [CT_CIV_SHORT] have to offer?
chinese: [CT_CIV_SHORT]能拿出什么来交易？

english: I'm listening...
chinese: 我听着呢……

english: We're always looking for a fair exchange, [CT_NAME]. Please go ahead.
chinese: 我们向来乐于公平交易，[CT_NAME]。请讲吧。

english: Go on.
chinese: 接着说。

english: Well, go ahead and put something on the table.
chinese: 好，把东西摆到台面上来吧。

english: All right. Let's hear it then.
chinese: 好吧。那就说来听听。

english: Agreed.
chinese: 成交。

english: All right then. Agreed.
chinese: 那好吧。成交。

english: Done.
chinese: 就这么定了。

english: Excellent. We are agreed.
chinese: 好极了。我们达成一致了。

english: Hrmph. This is highway robbery - but we'll take it.
chinese: 哼。这简直是抢劫——不过我们收下了。

english: Well, if that's the best you can do, I guess we'll take it. Done.
chinese: 罢了，若你只能出到这个价，那我看我们就收下吧。成交。

english: I agree to your terms.
chinese: 我同意你的条件。

english: I believe we can accept that. Agreed.
chinese: 我想我们可以接受。成交。

english: I think I can accept these terms. It is agreed.
chinese: 我想我可以接受这些条件。就这么定了。

english: It is agreed.
chinese: 就这么定了。

english: It's against my better judgment, but we'll take it. Done.
chinese: 这有违我的判断，但我们收下了。成交。

english: Sounds fair to me. Done.
chinese: 我看挺公道。成交。

english: That is acceptable to us. Done.
chinese: 我们可以接受。成交。

english: I dislike haggling. Agreed.
chinese: 我不喜欢讨价还价。成交。

english: The offer is a bit light - but we'll agree to it.
chinese: 这提议略显单薄——不过我们同意了。

english: We accept your fair offer.
chinese: 我们接受你这公道的提议。

english: We accept your gracious offer.
chinese: 我们接受你这慷慨的提议。

english: We are agreed then.
chinese: 那么我们就达成一致了。

english: We can accept these terms. Done.
chinese: 我们可以接受这些条件。成交。

english: We can do business along these lines. Agreed.
chinese: 照这样的路子，我们可以做买卖。成交。

english: We'll take it.
chinese: 我们收下了。

english: Very well, we'll take it.
chinese: 好吧，我们收下了。

english: It's a good deal. Done.
chinese: 这是笔划算的买卖。成交。

english: Your terms are acceptable.
chinese: 你的条件我们可以接受。

english: You are a hard bargainer, [CT_NAME]. Agreed.
chinese: 你可真是个难缠的谈判对手，[CT_NAME]。成交。

english: Excellent. It is done.
chinese: 好极了。就这么定了。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] thanks you. Done.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]谢谢你。成交。

english: You'll have to do better than that, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 你得拿出更好的条件才行，[CT_NAME]。

english: We really do not think this trade will benefit our people.
chinese: 我们实在觉得这笔交易对我们的子民没什么好处。

english: This proposal will not work for us.
chinese: 这个提议对我们行不通。

english: No, seriously. Quit fooling around: what's your offer?
chinese: 别，说正经的。别闹了：你到底出什么价？

english: That's not good enough, friend [CT_NAME].
chinese: 这还不够好，朋友[CT_NAME]。

english: Is that your final offer?
chinese: 这是你最后的报价吗？

english: I'm afraid that your offer is not acceptable to the [OUR_CIV_ADJ] people.
chinese: 恐怕你的提议[OUR_CIV_ADJ]人民无法接受。

english: No can do, my friend.
chinese: 这可不行，我的朋友。

english: We cannot afford to be so generous, [CT_NAME]. Try again.
chinese: 我们可没这么慷慨的家底，[CT_NAME]。再试试吧。

english: I don't think so. You'll have to do better than that.
chinese: 我看不行。你得拿出更好的条件才行。

english: We reject your proposal.  No thanks.
chinese: 我们拒绝你的提议。不必了。

english: Forget it.
chinese: 休想。

english: We reject your laughable offer.
chinese: 我们拒绝你这可笑的提议。

english: Just how gullible do you think I am, [CT_NAME]?
chinese: 你以为我有多好骗，[CT_NAME]？

english: Your generosity is underwhelming. Forget it.
chinese: 你这点“慷慨”真叫人失望。免谈。

english: This is totally unacceptable!
chinese: 这完全无法接受！

english: Just who do you think you're dealing with, [CT_NAME]?
chinese: 你以为你在跟谁打交道，[CT_NAME]？

english: Your offer is an insult to [OUR_CIV_SHORT].
chinese: 你的提议是对[OUR_CIV_SHORT]的侮辱。

english: Now that's just crazy talk.
chinese: 这简直是胡言乱语。

english: Quit wasting my time. Make a reasonable offer or go away.
chinese: 别浪费我的时间。要么开个合理的价，要么走人。

english: We're glad you accepted our offer.
chinese: 很高兴你接受了我们的提议。

english: It is wonderful that you have accepted.
chinese: 你能接受，真是太好了。

english: I'm glad that you found the offer acceptable, [CT_NAME]
chinese: 很高兴你觉得这提议可以接受，[CT_NAME]

english: Marvelous!
chinese: 妙极了！

english: You have chosen wisely, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 你的选择很明智，[CT_NAME]。

english: Wonderful! Let us celebrate!!
chinese: 太好了！让我们庆祝一番！！

english: It's a pleasure doing business with you.
chinese: 与你做生意真是愉快。

english: Excellent!
chinese: 好极了！

english: I'm glad that we could come to an agreement.
chinese: 很高兴我们能达成一致。

english: Cha-CHING!
chinese: 叮咚——进账啦！

english: All right then. We're agreed.
chinese: 那好吧。我们达成一致了。

english: Now you are beginning to show some sense, [CT_NAME]. Perhaps there is some hope for you yet.
chinese: 你总算开窍了，[CT_NAME]。看来你还有点救。

english: Done.
chinese: 就这么定了。

english: Excellent. Perhaps you are not as foolish as you look.
chinese: 好极了。看来你并不像样子那么蠢。

english: Mighty  [OUR_CIV_SHORT] thanks you. You may go now.
chinese: 强盛的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]谢谢你。你可以走了。

english: Thank you for your cooperation.
chinese: 多谢合作。

english: We thank you.
chinese: 我们谢谢你。

english: That is all for now.
chinese: 眼下就到这里。

english: Fine. It is done.
chinese: 行。就这么定了。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] thanks you and your petty little civilization.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]谢谢你和你那微不足道的小文明。

english: We're sorry you don't feel that our offer is reasonable.
chinese: 很遗憾你觉得我们的提议不合理。

english: Too bad. Do you have something different in mind?
chinese: 真可惜。你心里另有打算吗？

english: Let's hear an offer from you, then.
chinese: 那就说说你的提议吧。

english: All right. Why don't you put something on the table?
chinese: 好吧。不如你把东西摆到台面上来？

english: Well, do you wish to make a counter-proposal?
chinese: 那么，你可愿意提个反提议？

english: All right: let's hear your counter-proposal.
chinese: 好吧：说说你的反提议吧。

english: That is regrettable.
chinese: 那真是遗憾。

english: That is unfortunate.
chinese: 那真不巧。

english: Oh well. Perhaps next time, then.
chinese: 罢了。那就下次再说吧。

english: Well, perhaps you would care to suggest something then.
chinese: 那么，或许你愿意提点什么建议吧。

english: Well, you suggest something then!
chinese: 那你倒是提个建议啊！

english: How typical. Let's hear your brilliant. idea then.
chinese: 真是意料之中。那就说说你那高明的主意吧。

english: You annoy me, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 你惹恼我了，[CT_NAME]。

english: You are incredibly stubborn, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 你可真是顽固得很，[CT_NAME]。

english: You are remarkably short-sighted, [CT_NAME], to treat your betters thusly.
chinese: 你目光短浅得惊人，[CT_NAME]，竟敢这样对待你的尊长。

english: I suppose you have something better in mind?
chinese: 我想你另有高见吧？

english: Then quit wasting my time. Either make a counter-proposal or be gone.
chinese: 那就别浪费我的时间。要么提个反提议，要么滚。

english: Let's hear your idea, then.
chinese: 那就说说你的主意吧。

english: Then you put something on the table!
chinese: 那你倒是把东西摆到台面上来啊！

english: Does puny [CT_CIV_SHORT] wish to make a counter-proposal?
chinese: 渺小的[CT_CIV_SHORT]可愿意提个反提议？

english: How does this deal sound?
chinese: 这笔交易听着如何？

english: What do you think of this deal, [CT_NAME]?
chinese: 你觉得这笔交易怎么样，[CT_NAME]？

english: Do you find this offer tempting?
chinese: 这提议是否让你心动？

english: Here's my offer.
chinese: 这是我的提议。

english: I'm sure that you'll agree that this deal is fair...
chinese: 我相信你会认同这笔交易很公道……

english: And that's my final offer.
chinese: 这就是我最后的报价。

english: I don't see how a deal is possible.
chinese: 我看不出这笔交易怎么可能谈得成。

english: That's just crazy-talk. I don't think it can be done.
chinese: 这简直是胡言乱语。我看这办不到。

english: I'm sorry to say that no such deal is possible.
chinese: 很遗憾，这样的交易谈不成。

english: That can't be done, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 这办不到，[CT_NAME]。

english: I don't see how we can make such a trade.
chinese: 我看不出我们怎么能做成这样的交易。

english: We can't do that.
chinese: 那我们做不到。

english: That's impossible.
chinese: 那不可能。

english: Don't be foolish. That can't possibly be done.
chinese: 别犯傻了。那根本办不到。

english: Don't waste my time with impossibilities!
chinese: 别拿不可能的事来浪费我的时间！

english: What are you talking about? That's not possible.
chinese: 你在说什么胡话？那不可能。

english: Are you kidding? That can't be done!
chinese: 你在开玩笑吗？那办不到！

english: There's no way such a deal is possible.
chinese: 这样的交易绝无可能。

english: Perhaps it is time for all this bloodshed to end?
chinese: 或许，是时候结束这一切流血了？

english: We would like to offer up this city as a sign of our respect.
chinese: 我们愿献上这座城市，以示敬意。

english: Greetings, [CT_NAME]! What do you think of this deal?
chinese: 你好，[CT_NAME]！你觉得这笔交易怎么样？

english: The peace-loving people of [OUR_CIV_SHORT] seek a fair trade with [CT_CIV_SHORT]. How about it?
chinese: 爱好和平的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]子民想与[CT_CIV_SHORT]做一笔公道的交易。如何？

english: How does this sound to you, [CT_NAME]?
chinese: 你觉得这如何，[CT_NAME]？

english: What do you think of this deal, [CT_NAME]?
chinese: 你觉得这笔交易怎么样，[CT_NAME]？

english: My friend, can [OUR_CIV_SHORT] tempt you with this offer?
chinese: 我的朋友，[OUR_CIV_SHORT]这个提议可否打动你？

english: Let's make a deal!
chinese: 咱们做笔交易吧！

english: [CT_NAME], I'm making you an offer you can't refuse.
chinese: [CT_NAME]，我给你一个无法拒绝的提议。

english: Show some intelligence for a change, [CT_NAME]. Accept this deal.
chinese: 放聪明点，破天荒一回吧，[CT_NAME]。接受这笔交易。

english: The [OUR_EMPIRE] offers you this trade. I suggest you take it.
chinese: [OUR_EMPIRE]向你提出这笔交易。我劝你接下。

english: Here's our offer. Take it or leave it.
chinese: 这是我们的提议。要么接受，要么拉倒。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] offers your nasty little civilization the following deal.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]向你那讨厌的小文明提出如下交易。

english: Here's the deal.
chinese: 交易就是这样。

english: I'm afraid this deal will no longer work for us.
chinese: 恐怕这笔交易对我们已经行不通了。

english: I'm sorry, [CT_NAME], but this deal will no longer work for us.
chinese: 抱歉，[CT_NAME]，但这笔交易对我们已经行不通了。

english: All good things come to an end, unfortunately. Including this deal.
chinese: 可惜天下没有不散的筵席。这笔交易也一样。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] can no longer afford this deal, [CT_NAME].
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]再也负担不起这笔交易了，[CT_NAME]。

english: It's time to end this deal, friend.
chinese: 是时候结束这笔交易了，朋友。

english: If you don't mind, [OUR_CIV_SHORT] would like to cancel this deal.
chinese: 若你不介意，[OUR_CIV_SHORT]想取消这笔交易。

english: The [OUR_CIV_ADJ] people are no longer interested in this deal, [CT_NAME].
chinese: [OUR_CIV_ADJ]人民对这笔交易不再感兴趣了，[CT_NAME]。

english: This deal is over.
chinese: 这笔交易结束了。

english: We're ending this deal, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 我们要终止这笔交易，[CT_NAME]。

english: We're sick of this deal. And of you, too, frankly.
chinese: 我们受够了这笔交易。老实说，也受够了你。

english: We are terminating this deal, [CT_NAME], effective immediately.
chinese: 我们即刻终止这笔交易，[CT_NAME]，立即生效。

english: This deal no longer suits our needs. It is canceled.
chinese: 这笔交易不再符合我们的需要。取消。

english: [OUR_NAME] thanks you on behalf of the grateful [OUR_CIV_ADJ] people!
chinese: [OUR_NAME]谨代表满怀感激的[OUR_CIV_ADJ]人民向你致谢！

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] acknowledges your friendship. Thank you.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]铭记你的友谊。谢谢你。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] graciously acknowledges your friendship, [CT_NAME].
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]郑重铭记你的友谊，[CT_NAME]。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] salutes its friend, the tiny nation of [CT_CIV_SHORT].
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]向其友邦、渺小的[CT_CIV_SHORT]之国致敬。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] salutes you, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]向你致敬，[CT_NAME]！

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] thanks you, [CT_NAME].
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]谢谢你，[CT_NAME]。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] thanks you, fair and generous [CT_NAME]!
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]谢谢你，公道又慷慨的[CT_NAME]！

english: [CT_NAME], my people thank you.
chinese: [CT_NAME]，我的子民谢谢你。

english: Excellent! I'm quite pleased. Let's sit down and have a jolly cup of tea, shall we?
chinese: 好极了！我很欣慰。让我们坐下来，痛快地喝杯茶，好吗？

english: Good decision. We must build a closer bond - or else!
chinese: 明智之举。我们必须建立更紧密的纽带——否则可有你好受的！

english: I [OUR_NAME], Godlike Ruler of the Mighty [OUR_EMPIRE], do hereby offer my sincerest thanks to my good friend, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 我，[OUR_NAME]，强盛[OUR_EMPIRE]之神一般的统治者，谨在此向我的好友[CT_NAME]致以最诚挚的谢意。

english: I am glad that we have concluded this arrangement amicably, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 很高兴我们友好地了结了这桩安排，[CT_NAME]。

english: I am so happy that our two nations can rise above petty rivalries like this! We will set an example the whole world will follow!
chinese: 我真高兴，我们两国竟能超越如此琐碎的宿怨！我们将树立起一个全世界都会效仿的榜样！

english: I am SO pleased that we have been able to come to a fair agreement, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: 我真是太高兴了，我们竟能达成一份公道的协议，[CT_NAME]！

english: I appreciate this, friend [CT_NAME]. Thanks from all the [OUR_CIV_ADJ] people!
chinese: 我很感激，朋友[CT_NAME]。全体[OUR_CIV_ADJ]人民都谢谢你！

english: I bow before you in friendship, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: 我以友谊向你俯首，[CT_NAME]！

english: I congratulate you on your common sense, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 我为你的明智决断向你道贺，[CT_NAME]。

english: I thank you. Now I'm sure that you have pressing business elsewhere...
chinese: 谢谢你。现在我想你别处还有要紧事吧……

english: I will sacrifice fifty warriors in honor of your friendship!
chinese: 我将献祭五十名战士，以彰显你我的友谊！

english: I, [OUR_NAME], ruler of way too many places to mention, do hereby thank my good friend, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: 我，[OUR_NAME]，多得数不清的疆土之统治者，谨在此感谢我的好友[CT_NAME]！

english: It has been a pleasure doing business with you, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 与你做生意真是愉快，[CT_NAME]。

english: It is good that we can come together as equals, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 我们能以平等的身份走到一起，真好，[CT_NAME]。

english: We enjoyed speaking with you [CT_NAME]. Odd, since you are so far inferior, but personality goes a long way.
chinese: 与你交谈让我们很愉快，[CT_NAME]。奇怪的是，你分明如此低劣，可人格魅力却能弥补许多。

english: You are the wind beneath my wings, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: 你是我翅膀下的风，[CT_NAME]！

english: You have our gratitude.
chinese: 承蒙你的美意。

english: Many thanks, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: 多谢，[CT_NAME]！

english: Many thanks.
chinese: 多谢。

english: May the heavens bless and sanctify the friendship between our two great people!
chinese: 愿上苍降福，圣化我们两大民族之间的友谊！

english: May the bond between [OUR_NAME] and [CT_NAME] grow ever stronger!.
chinese: 愿[OUR_NAME]与[CT_NAME]之间的情谊日益深厚！

english: May the friendship between [OUR_CIV_SHORT] and [CT_CIV_SHORT] last for many years!
chinese: 愿[OUR_CIV_SHORT]与[CT_CIV_SHORT]之间的友谊长存多年！

english: Did you ever know that you're my hero? You're everything I wish I could be.
chinese: 你可知道你是我心中的英雄？你就是我梦寐以求想成为的那一切。

english: On behalf of the [OUR_CIV_ADJ] people, I thank you!
chinese: 我谨代表[OUR_CIV_ADJ]人民，感谢你！

english: On behalf of the people of [OUR_CIV_SHORT], I thank you and all the [CT_CIV_ADJ] people.
chinese: 我谨代表[OUR_CIV_SHORT]的子民，感谢你和全体[CT_CIV_ADJ]人民。

english: Our work is concluded. You may go.
chinese: 我们的事已经了结。你可以走了。

english: Our work is finished here, is it not? Well, then, don't let me keep you.
chinese: 我们这儿的事都办完了，不是吗？那好，我就不留你了。

english: Thank me?  No, no...thank you, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: 谢我？不不……该谢的是你，[CT_NAME]！

english: Thank you, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: 谢谢你，[CT_NAME]！

english: Thank you, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 谢谢你，[CT_NAME]。

english: Thank you, [CT_NAME].  Is there anything else?
chinese: 谢谢你，[CT_NAME]。还有别的事吗？

english: Thank you, [CT_NAME]. May both our people profit from our continued friendship!
chinese: 谢谢你，[CT_NAME]。愿我们两族的子民都能从这份长存的友谊中获益！

english: Thank you.  Your cooperation has been noted.
chinese: 谢谢你。你的合作我们记下了。

english: Thanks, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 多谢，[CT_NAME]。

english: It's been a small slice of heaven. I mean that sincerely.
chinese: 这真是片刻的天堂。我是真心的。

english: Thanks.  Will that be all?
chinese: 谢谢。就这些吗？

english: You have our gratitude.
chinese: 承蒙你的美意。

english: That will be all for now, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 眼下就到这里，[CT_NAME]。

english: There. That's a job well done, don't you think?
chinese: 瞧。这事办得漂亮，你说是不是？

english: That's done, then. Thanks and farewell!
chinese: 那这就了结了。多谢，再会！

english: The [OUR_CIV_ADJ] people graciously thank the people of - whatever your culture's name is.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_ADJ]人民郑重感谢——你们那个叫什么名字来着的文明的子民。

english: The [OUR_EMPIRE] thanks you, [CT_NAME]. You may go now.
chinese: [OUR_EMPIRE]谢谢你，[CT_NAME]。你可以走了。

english: We thank our friends and partners, the [CT_CIV_ADJ] people!
chinese: 我们感谢我们的朋友和伙伴，[CT_CIV_ADJ]人民！

english: We thank our partner, [CT_CIV_SHORT], for coming to a fair and just agreement.
chinese: 我们感谢我们的伙伴[CT_CIV_SHORT]，达成了一份公正公道的协议。

english: We work together well, [CT_NAME]. I look forward to many more mutually profitable arrangements in the future!
chinese: 我们合作得很好，[CT_NAME]。我期盼日后有更多互利互惠的安排！

english: We're done here, right? Well, don't let me keep you. Thanks and good bye.
chinese: 我们这儿的事都办完了，对吧？那好，我就不留你了。多谢，再见。

english: Yes, I believe we will both profit from this deal.  I look forward to doing business with you again.
chinese: 是的，我相信我们都会从这笔交易中获益。期待再次与你做生意。

english: You are almost an equal in cunning and martial prowess, [CT_NAME]. I, [OUR_NAME], thank you for your visit.
chinese: 论狡黠与武勇，你几乎称得上是我的对手了，[CT_NAME]。我，[OUR_NAME]，感谢你的到访。

english: You are wise beyond your years, friend [CT_NAME]. [OUR_CIV_SHORT] offers you its sincerest thanks.
chinese: 你的睿智远超你的年岁，朋友[CT_NAME]。[OUR_CIV_SHORT]向你致以最诚挚的谢意。

english: You have [OUR_CIV_SHORT]'s thanks.
chinese: 你得到了[OUR_CIV_SHORT]的谢意。

english: You have chosen wisely, [CT_NAME]. It is important to maintain good relations with your betters, don't you agree?
chinese: 你的选择很明智，[CT_NAME]。与尊长维系良好关系很重要，你说是不是？

english: You have my eternal gratitude, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 我对你永怀感激，[CT_NAME]。

english: You have our gratitude.
chinese: 承蒙你的美意。

english: You have our thanks.
chinese: 我们谢谢你。

english: You make me so happy, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: 你让我如此欢喜，[CT_NAME]！

english: You show great wisdom and acumen in picking your friends, [CT_NAME]. The [OUR_EMPIRE] thanks you.
chinese: 你择友的眼光尽显智慧与卓识，[CT_NAME]。[OUR_EMPIRE]谢谢你。

english: You show great wisdom and friendship. [OUR_CIV_SHORT] thanks you!
chinese: 你尽显智慧与友谊。[OUR_CIV_SHORT]谢谢你！

english: Your fair and courteous dealings with the [OUR_CIV_ADJ] people will not be forgotten.
chinese: 你与[OUR_CIV_ADJ]人民公道而礼貌的往来，我们不会忘记。

english: You have [OUR_CIV_SHORT]'s thanks.
chinese: 你得到了[OUR_CIV_SHORT]的谢意。

english: It appears that your visit was not a complete waste. Come back again when you have something else to offer the [OUR_EMPIRE].
chinese: 看来你这趟没白来。等你还有别的东西可献给[OUR_EMPIRE]时，再来吧。

english: Yours is a friendly and accommodating little culture. We thank you.
chinese: 你们是个友善而随和的小文明。我们谢谢你们。

english: As I see it, these are our current deals.
chinese: 依我看，这些就是我们现有的交易。

english: These are our active deals.
chinese: 这些是我们生效中的交易。

english: [CT_NAME], these are the deals we have agreed upon.
chinese: [CT_NAME]，这些是我们已经谈妥的交易。

english: These are the deals we have with the [CT_EMPIRE].
chinese: 这些是我们与[CT_EMPIRE]之间的交易。

english: Always happy to help...
chinese: 乐意效劳……

english: Sorry, but you press us too hard.
chinese: 抱歉，你逼得我们太紧了。

english: We accede to your unreasonable demands.
chinese: 我们只好答应你这无理的要求。

english: I accept your terms, for now. But you just wait until next time!
chinese: 眼下我接受你的条件。但你就等着瞧下回吧！

english: It appears that I have no choice but to agree.
chinese: 看来除了答应，我别无选择。

english: All right, then. But just remember: what goes around comes around!
chinese: 那好吧。不过你给我记住：善恶终有报！

english: Sure: kick a civilization when it's down. I accept your terms.
chinese: 行啊：趁人之危、落井下石。我接受你的条件。

english: I agree to your terms. For now.
chinese: 眼下，我接受你的条件。

english: Always happy to help!
chinese: 乐意效劳！

english: We reject your meaningless threats!
chinese: 我们拒绝你毫无意义的威胁！

english: How dare you insult glorious [OUR_CIV_SHORT] with your stupid demands!
chinese: 你竟敢用你那愚蠢的要求侮辱光荣的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]！

english: Not bloody likely.
chinese: 门儿都没有。

english: Not on my watch!
chinese: 别想在我眼皮底下得逞！

english: Never!
chinese: 绝不！

english: You badly underestimate the [OUR_EMPIRE], [CT_NAME]. We would never agree to any such thing.
chinese: 你严重低估了[OUR_EMPIRE]，[CT_NAME]。我们绝不会答应这种事。

english: We see that you could probably use a little help.
chinese: 我们看得出，你或许正需要一点援手。

english: Perhaps this could be of assistance to you, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 或许这对你能有些帮助，[CT_NAME]。

english: Here's a little something from us to you.
chinese: 这是我们给你的一点小小心意。

english: Here, my friend: you might need this.
chinese: 拿去吧，我的朋友：你或许用得上这个。

english: Would this be of any use to you, [CT_NAME]?
chinese: 这对你可有用处，[CT_NAME]？

english: The [OUR_CIV_ADJ] people are feeling quite generous today, [CT_NAME]. Perhaps this could be of some use to you.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_ADJ]人民今天颇为慷慨，[CT_NAME]。或许这对你能有些用处。

english: Charity begins at home, [CT_NAME]. Care to give us some?
chinese: 仁爱当自家门始，[CT_NAME]。可愿分我们一些？

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] requires your assistance, friend [CT_NAME]. I hope that you will not disappoint us.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]需要你的援助，朋友[CT_NAME]。但愿你不会让我们失望。

english: I have always relied on the kindness of strangers, [CT_NAME]. Can you help?
chinese: 我向来仰仗陌生人的善意，[CT_NAME]。你能帮个忙吗？

english: A friend in need is a friend indeed, [CT_NAME]. Care to help us out?
chinese: 患难见真情，[CT_NAME]。可愿帮我们一把？

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] could use your assistance, [CT_NAME].
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]用得上你的援助，[CT_NAME]。

english: Could you possibly spare us this, [CT_NAME]?
chinese: 你可否匀出这个给我们，[CT_NAME]？

english: Supplying us with this would go a long way towards healing the unfortunate rift between our peoples, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 供给我们这个，将大大有助于弥合我们两族之间那道不幸的裂痕，[CT_NAME]。

english: I find that [OUR_CIV_SHORT] needs your aid, [CT_NAME]. I'm certain you won't disappoint us.
chinese: 我发现[OUR_CIV_SHORT]需要你的援助，[CT_NAME]。我相信你不会让我们失望。

english: As difficult as it may be to believe, you actually have something that we could use.
chinese: 尽管难以置信，你手上竟真有我们用得上的东西。

english: Your assistance at this vital time will do much towards regaining [OUR_CIV_SHORT]'s friendship, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 在这紧要关头伸出援手，将大大有助于重获[OUR_CIV_SHORT]的友谊，[CT_NAME]。

english: Despite our differences, I believe that our two nations have much in common. For example, you have this and we need it.
chinese: 尽管我们分歧重重，我却相信我们两国有不少共通之处。比方说，你有这个，而我们正需要它。

english: We could use your assistance, [CT_NAME]. Do not disappoint us.
chinese: 我们用得上你的援助，[CT_NAME]。别让我们失望。

english: How disappointing.
chinese: 真令人失望。

english: Well, dang.
chinese: 哼，可恶。

english: You are really not a very giving person, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 你可真是个吝啬的人，[CT_NAME]。

english: Very well. We shall say nothing more of this - for the moment.
chinese: 好吧。此事我们就不再多说了——暂且如此。

english: You have chosen foolishly, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 你的选择很愚蠢，[CT_NAME]。

english: Very well. But greed will be your ultimate downfall, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 好吧。但贪婪终将成为你的覆灭之因，[CT_NAME]。

english: We shall remember this, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 我们会记住这件事的，[CT_NAME]。

english: How shortsighted of you.
chinese: 你真是目光短浅。

english: That's not very nice of you, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 你这么做可不厚道，[CT_NAME]。

english: We'll remember this.
chinese: 我们会记住这件事的。

english: You foolish person.
chinese: 你这个蠢货。

english: I expected better of you, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 我本以为你会做得更好，[CT_NAME]。

english: I hope you don't come to regret this, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 但愿你不会为此后悔，[CT_NAME]。

english: Very well. On your own head be it.
chinese: 好吧。后果由你自负。

english: As you will.
chinese: 随你便。

english: Remember, what goes around comes around...
chinese: 记住，善恶终有报……

english: Fine. See if we help you out when you need it.
chinese: 行。那就看看你有难时我们帮不帮你吧。

english: That's too bad. For the both of us, I fear.
chinese: 那真糟糕。我担心，这对你我都是坏事。

english: We demand the following in tribute!
chinese: 我们要求你献上如下贡品！

english: [CT_NAME], meet our demands or suffer the consequences.
chinese: [CT_NAME]，满足我们的要求，否则自食其果。

english: It would be wise for you to give us what we want.
chinese: 你最好乖乖交出我们想要的东西。

english: Give us what we want or prepare to be destroyed.
chinese: 交出我们想要的东西，否则准备灰飞烟灭吧。

english: Be wise [CT_NAME] and give in to our demands.
chinese: 放聪明点，[CT_NAME]，乖乖答应我们的要求。

english: We can do this the easy way, or the hard way. Which do you prefer?
chinese: 这事我们可以好好来，也可以来硬的。你想选哪样？

english: For the sake of our long friendship, [CT_NAME], will you not give us this small present?
chinese: 看在我们多年交情的份上，[CT_NAME]，你不愿送我们这份小小的礼物吗？

english: Friend [CT_NAME], we are in some need of assistance. Will you not help your longstanding friend and ally?
chinese: 朋友[CT_NAME]，我们有些需要援助。你不愿帮帮你的老朋友、老盟友吗？

english: Give us what we want, [CT_NAME], lest we come and take it.
chinese: 交出我们想要的东西，[CT_NAME]，免得我们亲自来取。

english: This is what we need, [CT_NAME]. Surely our continued friendship is worth far more than that!
chinese: 这就是我们需要的东西，[CT_NAME]。我们长存的友谊，分明远比这值钱得多！

english: The [OUR_EMPIRE] would be quite grateful if your terribly vulnerable country gave us what we want.
chinese: 若你那不堪一击的国家把我们想要的东西交出来，[OUR_EMPIRE]会相当感激。

english: Our continued friendship provides many benefits, [CT_NAME]. Surely it is worth this small tribute in return?
chinese: 我们长存的友谊带来诸多好处，[CT_NAME]。作为回报，这点小小的贡品分明是值得的吧？

english: Pay it forward, [CT_NAME]. Please?
chinese: 把善意传递下去吧，[CT_NAME]。求你了？

english: The only thing you have to fear is the terrible consequence of not giving me what I want.
chinese: 你唯一该惧怕的，就是不给我想要的东西所带来的可怕后果。

english: The best things in life are free, [CT_NAME]. Unfortunately, our continued friendship isn't one of them.
chinese: 人生最美好的东西都是免费的，[CT_NAME]。可惜，我们长存的友谊不在其列。

english: The gods demand sacrifice, [CT_NAME]. If your civilization is to exist for much longer, I recommend that you comply.
chinese: 诸神索要祭品，[CT_NAME]。若想让你的文明再多存续些时日，我劝你照办。

english: That's quite a nice little civilization you have going there, [CT_NAME]. It would be very unfortunate if something bad were to happen to it... We understand each other, do we not?
chinese: 你那个小文明经营得不错嘛，[CT_NAME]。要是出了什么意外，那可就太不幸了……你我心照不宣，对吧？

english: [CT_NAME], please give us the following immediately. Think of it as an investment in our continued friendship.
chinese: [CT_NAME]，请立刻把以下东西交给我们。就当是对我们长存友谊的一笔投资吧。

english: I want this right now. Do not make me angry - you wouldn't like me when I'm angry...
chinese: 我现在就要这个。别惹我发火——我发起火来可不好受……

english: I was going to demand that you sacrifice 1000 warriors to my greatness, [CT_NAME], but if you prefer, you can give me this.
chinese: 我本想命你献祭一千名战士来敬奉我的伟大，[CT_NAME]，不过你若愿意，也可以把这个给我。

english: The world is a better place because of our friendship, [CT_NAME]; don't you agree? Surely this isn't too large a price to pay to insure that it continues...
chinese: 因了我们的友谊，这世界才更美好，[CT_NAME]，你说是不是？为保这份友谊延续下去，这点代价想必不算太大……

english: The [CT_CIV_ADJ] people are in great need, [CT_NAME]. Do not disappoint us.
chinese: [CT_CIV_ADJ]人民正急需援助，[CT_NAME]。别让我们失望。

english: My armies thirst for new lands to conquer, [CT_NAME]. Would you care to ensure that they aren't yours?
chinese: 我的大军渴望征服新的疆土，[CT_NAME]。你可愿保证那疆土不是你的？

english: For the sake of our continued friendship, provide the great people of the [OUR_NAME] with tribute.
chinese: 看在我们长存友谊的份上，向[OUR_NAME]的伟大子民献上贡品吧。

english: Give us what we want, [CT_NAME] - it is the will of the gods.
chinese: 交出我们想要的东西，[CT_NAME]——这是诸神的旨意。

english: Peace demands sacrifice, [CT_NAME]. From you.
chinese: 和平需要牺牲，[CT_NAME]。由你来牺牲。

english: I hope you see, [CT_NAME], that it is in your country's best interest to give us what we want.
chinese: 我希望你明白，[CT_NAME]，交出我们想要的东西，符合你国家的最大利益。

english: Give us what we want, now! Or face imminent destruction!
chinese: 立刻交出我们想要的东西！否则就等着大祸临头吧！

english: Forsake greed, friend!  Provide me with tribute, or risk the anger of the [OUR_CIV_ADJ] people.
chinese: 抛开贪念吧，朋友！向我献上贡品，否则就要冒着触怒[OUR_CIV_ADJ]人民的风险。

english: Bestow gifts upon your friends and you are likely to be rewarded a hundred times over.  Ignore the advice of wise-men, and you risk being flogged about the head, neck, face, and shoulders.
chinese: 向朋友馈赠礼物，你很可能会得到百倍的回报。无视智者的忠告，你就要冒着头、颈、脸、肩都被抽个不停的风险。

english: The mighty [OUR_EMPIRE] thanks you for your generous gift, [CT_NAME]. Now hand it over.
chinese: 强盛的[OUR_EMPIRE]感谢你这慷慨的馈赠，[CT_NAME]。现在，交出来吧。

english: Friendly [OUR_CIV_SHORT] requires a goodwill gesture from our firm yet surprisingly vulnerable ally, [CT_CIV_SHORT].
chinese: 友善的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]，需要我们那坚定却出奇脆弱的盟友[CT_CIV_SHORT]表示一点善意。

english: Usually, when I see something I want, I just come over and take it. Consider this your lucky day.
chinese: 通常，我看上什么东西，就直接过来拿走。就当今天是你走运吧。

english: The truth is, [OUR_CIV_SHORT] is stronger than your empire, [CT_NAME]. It would be wise of you to give us what we want.
chinese: 事实是，[OUR_CIV_SHORT]比你的帝国更强大，[CT_NAME]。乖乖交出我们想要的东西，才是明智之举。

english: Give us this or our mighty Cossacks will roam across your ravaged country, burning your cities, stealing your pigs and making lewd gestures at your women!
chinese: 交出这个，否则我们强悍的哥萨克就要踏遍你满目疮痍的国土，焚烧你的城市，抢走你的猪，还要对你的女人做出下流的动作！

english: A present for me? Why, it's just what I wanted! How ever did you guess?
chinese: 给我的礼物？哎呀，这正是我想要的！你怎么就猜到了呢？

english: Heaven is on our side, [CT_NAME]. I pray that you know what's good for you.
chinese: 上苍站在我们这边，[CT_NAME]。我祈祷你识时务、知深浅。

english: Give us what we want now, [CT_NAME], and we shall repay you a hundredfold at some distant later date.
chinese: 现在就交出我们想要的东西，[CT_NAME]，日后某个遥远的时日，我们会百倍偿还你。

english: The honor of [OUR_CIV_SHORT] requires that we ask you to give us a small donation.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]的荣誉，要求我们请你捐赠一份小小的献礼。

english: For the sake of friendship, you might want to consider giving us a small gift.
chinese: 看在友谊的份上，你或许该考虑送我们一份小小的礼物。

english: Agree to our demands, [CT_NAME], or be prepared to fight!
chinese: 答应我们的要求，[CT_NAME]，否则准备开战！

english: Know that [OUR_CIV_SHORT] stands by [CT_CIV_SHORT]'s side as friend and equal Now - about our fee...
chinese: 要知道，[OUR_CIV_SHORT]作为朋友和平等的伙伴，与[CT_CIV_SHORT]并肩而立。那么——说说我们的报酬吧……

english: Peace with the [OUR_EMPIRE] comes with a price, [CT_NAME]. Will you pay?
chinese: 与[OUR_EMPIRE]的和平是有代价的，[CT_NAME]。你可愿付？

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] demands that you give us the following tribute. Our [OUR_BEST_UNIT] await your response.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]要求你献上如下贡品。我们的[OUR_BEST_UNIT]正等候你的答复。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] needs this, [CT_NAME]. Will you give it to us, or must we fight for it?
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]需要这个，[CT_NAME]。你是乖乖交给我们，还是要我们为它一战？

english: Hello, [CT_NAME]! The price of freedom has just gone up.
chinese: 你好，[CT_NAME]！自由的价码刚刚涨了。

english: I cannot tell a lie, [CT_NAME]: we want your stuff. Kindly give it to us at your earliest convenience.
chinese: 我不能说谎，[CT_NAME]：我们想要你的东西。请你尽早把它交给我们。

english: By the glory of God, I, [OUR_NAME], mightiest of his servants, do request a small donation from you, [CT_NAME]. You would be wise to consider my request carefully.
chinese: 以神的荣光之名，我，[OUR_NAME]，他最强大的仆从，向你请求一份小小的捐赠，[CT_NAME]。你最好慎重考虑我的请求。

english: The [OUR_EMPIRE] requests from you a small donation, [CT_NAME]. Or, if you prefer, we can battle until one of us is destroyed.
chinese: [OUR_EMPIRE]向你请求一份小小的捐赠，[CT_NAME]。或者，你若愿意，我们也可以厮杀到一方灭亡为止。

english: Would you care to take part in our share-the-wealth program, [CT_NAME]?
chinese: 你可愿加入我们的共富计划，[CT_NAME]？

english: Furnish [OUR_CIV_SHORT] with these gifts and we will tolerate your existence for a little while longer.
chinese: 把这些礼物供给[OUR_CIV_SHORT]，我们就再容忍你多存在一阵子。

english: It is customary for puny mortals to show their devotion by giving their goddess a gift. Or if they prefer they can be cut into small pieces and fed to the royal crocodiles.
chinese: 渺小的凡人向女神献上礼物以表虔诚，本是惯例。若他们更中意，也可以被剁成小块，喂给王室的鳄鱼。

english: My dear [CT_NAME], [OUR_CIV_SHORT] can make life very difficult indeed for [CT_CIV_SHORT]. Give us what we want or suffer the consequences.
chinese: 我亲爱的[CT_NAME]，[OUR_CIV_SHORT]完全能让[CT_CIV_SHORT]的日子举步维艰。交出我们想要的东西，否则自食其果。

english: We have needs, [CT_NAME]. Please comply.
chinese: 我们有所需要，[CT_NAME]。请照办。

english: I'll keep this short: comply with our demands or suffer the consequences. That is all.
chinese: 我长话短说：答应我们的要求，否则自食其果。就这样。

english: Blackmail is such an ugly word, [CT_NAME]. I prefer to call it, "extortion."
chinese: “敲诈”这个词太难听了，[CT_NAME]。我更愿意称之为“勒索”。

english: Do you choose to cravenly lick our boots and give us what we want, or to stand and fight us in a heroic but doomed last stand?
chinese: 你是要卑躬屈膝地舔我们的靴子，把想要的东西交出来，还是要挺身与我们一战、来一场英勇却注定失败的负隅顽抗？

english: I have sacrificed many foes, [CT_NAME]. Give me what I want or you may be next.
chinese: 我已献祭过许多仇敌，[CT_NAME]。交出我想要的东西，否则下一个可能就是你。

english: A small donation would help insure continued frirendship between our two peoples, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 一份小小的捐赠，将有助于确保我们两族之间友谊长存，[CT_NAME]。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] requests a small donation from their good friends, the [CT_CIV_ADJ] people.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]向他们的好友、[CT_CIV_ADJ]人民，请求一份小小的捐赠。

english: We are bigger and stronger than you, [CT_NAME]. You must give us tribute, or suffer the consequences.
chinese: 我们比你更强大，[CT_NAME]。你必须向我们进贡，否则自食其果。

english: My generosity is known the world over, [CT_NAME]. How about yours?
chinese: 我的慷慨闻名于世，[CT_NAME]。你的呢？

english: Give us what we want, [CT_NAME], or 20,000 screaming warriors will come and take it.
chinese: 交出我们想要的东西，[CT_NAME]，否则两万名嘶吼的战士就会前来夺取。

english: You may purchase your continued existence with this, [CT_NAME]. I suggest that you be sensible and do so.
chinese: 你可以用这个买下你继续存在的权利，[CT_NAME]。我劝你识相点，照办吧。

english: If you wish to ensure [CT_CIV_SHORT]'s continued survival, you would be wise to comply with my demands.
chinese: 你若想确保[CT_CIV_SHORT]继续存续，乖乖答应我的要求才是明智之举。

english: The [CT_EMPIRE] is strong, [CT_NAME]. But are you sure that it is as strong as Mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT]? Deny us our tribute and you may have a chance to find out.
chinese: [CT_EMPIRE]很强大，[CT_NAME]。可你确定它强得过强盛的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]吗？拒不进贡，你或许就有机会一探究竟。

english: Hand this over or die.
chinese: 交出来，否则受死。

english: I do so hope that we can remain friends, [CT_NAME]. The world just wouldn't be as much fun with you not in it.
chinese: 我真心盼着我们能继续做朋友，[CT_NAME]。这世界若少了你，可就没这么有趣了。

english: Mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT] is leading the battle against evil, godless, heathen, barbarians, [CT_NAME]. It is time to show your appreciation.
chinese: 强盛的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]正率军讨伐邪恶、渎神、异教的野蛮人，[CT_NAME]。是时候表表你的感激了。

english: Given the many concessions we have granted you previously, is it not time for you to give Mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT] something in return?
chinese: 鉴于此前我们已给过你诸多让步，如今你是不是也该回报强盛的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]些什么了？

english: Think well, [CT_NAME]: if you give us tribute, our friendship will continue. If not, we will have to seriously re-evaluate our relationship.
chinese: 好好想想，[CT_NAME]：你若进贡，我们的友谊便得以延续。若不然，我们就得认真重新掂量你我的关系了。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] demands that you pay her tribute.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]要求你向她进贡。

english: Give us what we want or be destroyed.
chinese: 交出我们想要的东西，否则灰飞烟灭。

english: Mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT] demands that you acknowledge her superiority with a small token of respect.
chinese: 强盛的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]要求你献上一点敬意，以承认她的优越。

english: The superior [OUR_CIV_ADJ] civilization is worthy of tribute. Dispense goods to us, and we'll refrain from sending our [OUR_BEST_UNIT] to crush you.
chinese: 优越的[OUR_CIV_ADJ]文明配得上贡品。把财物献给我们，我们就不派[OUR_BEST_UNIT]去碾碎你。

english: Time is short and so too will be the memory of [CT_CIV_SHORT] should you deny me this token of respect.
chinese: 时日无多，你若拒绝献上这份敬意，[CT_CIV_SHORT]留在世间的记忆也将同样短暂。

english: I wonder if you would consider giving us a small gift, [CT_NAME], in honor of the timeless friendship between Mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT] and your weak and defenseless people?
chinese: 我在想，你可愿送我们一份小小的礼物，[CT_NAME]，以纪念强盛的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]与你那弱小无助的子民之间那份永恒的友谊？

english: For the sake of your country's continued survival, I suggest that you comply with our demands.
chinese: 为了你国家的存续，我劝你答应我们的要求。

english: That certainly is a nice little civilization you have there, [CT_NAME]. It would be unfortunate if something were to happen to it...
chinese: 你那个小文明确实不错，[CT_NAME]。要是出了什么意外，那可就太不幸了……

english: Don't think of this as a demand for tribute, [CT_NAME]. Think of it as an investment in world peace.
chinese: 别把这当成进贡的勒索，[CT_NAME]。就把它当成一笔对世界和平的投资吧。

english: It is only proper that the vassal states provide tribute to their lord and protector. That would be me.
chinese: 附庸之国向他们的君主与庇护者进贡，本是天经地义。那位君主，便是我。

english: Your weakness is contemptible, #CT_NAME! Give us what we want or perish!
chinese: 你的软弱令人不齿，#CT_NAME！交出我们想要的东西，否则受死！

english: If you wish your pathetic civilization to survive, [CT_NAME], you had better comply with our demands!
chinese: 你若想让你那可悲的文明活下去，[CT_NAME]，最好乖乖答应我们的要求！

english: For too long have the glorious [CT_CIV_ADJ] workers put up with your contemptible bourgoise insolence! It's time for an immediate redistribution of wealth!
chinese: 光荣的[CT_CIV_ADJ]工人容忍你那可鄙的资产阶级傲慢已经太久了！是时候立刻重新分配财富了！

english: Glorious [OUR_CIV_SHORT] requires from you a token of aubmission. Or would you prefer that we wipe [CT_CIV_SHORT] from the face of the planet?
chinese: 光荣的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]要求你献上一份臣服的表示。还是说，你更愿意让我们把[CT_CIV_SHORT]从这颗星球上抹去？

english: Conventional wisdom suggests that you bequeath certain goods to us or be destroyed.
chinese: 依常理而论，你该把某些财物献给我们，否则灰飞烟灭。

english: Give [OUR_CIV_SHORT] what is due her, [CT_NAME]! We shall not ask a second time.
chinese: 把[OUR_CIV_SHORT]应得的东西交给她，[CT_NAME]！我们不会问第二次。

english: The [OUR_CIV_ADJ] Folk have put up with your insults long enough! Pay us the following or suffer the consequences!
chinese: [OUR_CIV_ADJ]子民容忍你的侮辱已经够久了！献上如下贡品，否则自食其果！

english: If you wish to delay your destruction, [CT_NAME], give us what we want.
chinese: 你若想推迟你的覆灭，[CT_NAME]，就交出我们想要的东西。

english: To be honest, raw greed is the only thing stopping us from destroying your puny civilization. Pay us what we want, or perish.
chinese: 老实说，唯有赤裸裸的贪念才拦着我们没去毁灭你那渺小的文明。交出我们想要的东西，否则受死。

english: Foolish [CT_NAME]! Give us what we want and you may live for yet another day!
chinese: 愚蠢的[CT_NAME]！交出我们想要的东西，你或许还能再多活一天！

english: Mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT]'s protection comes at a price, [CT_NAME]. You would be wise to pay it.
chinese: 强盛的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]的庇护是有代价的，[CT_NAME]。你最好乖乖付清。

english: I believe in peace at any price, [CT_NAME]. This is your price.
chinese: 我信奉不惜代价的和平，[CT_NAME]。这就是你要付的代价。

english: Do not let foolish pride cause the downfall of your people, [CT_NAME]. Pay us what we want - or be destroyed!
chinese: 别让愚蠢的骄傲招致你子民的覆灭，[CT_NAME]。交出我们想要的东西——否则灰飞烟灭！

english: Time is short and so too will be the memory of [CT_CIV_SHORT] should you deny me this token of respect.
chinese: 时日无多，你若拒绝献上这份敬意，[CT_CIV_SHORT]留在世间的记忆也将同样短暂。

english: When you find a hungry tiger at your door, commen sense says that you feed him.
chinese: 当一头饿虎堵在你门口时，常识告诉你：喂饱它。

english: [OUR_CIV_SHORT] requires tribute from inferior cultures such as yours. Comply or be destroyed.
chinese: [OUR_CIV_SHORT]向你这样低劣的文明索取贡品。照办，否则灰飞烟灭。

english: Acceed to our demands or face us in battle.
chinese: 答应我们的要求，否则战场上见。

english: Resistance is futile! Comply with our demands or face destruction!
chinese: 抵抗是徒劳的！答应我们的要求，否则灰飞烟灭！

english: Ah, [CT_NAME]. I have an excellent deal to offer you: give us what we want, and we will not crush you. Does that not sound fair?
chinese: 啊，[CT_NAME]。我有个绝佳的交易要给你：交出我们想要的东西，我们就不碾碎你。这难道不公道吗？

english: Some enjoy licking our boots, [CT_NAME]. How about you give it a try?
chinese: 有些人以舔我们的靴子为乐，[CT_NAME]。你要不要也来试试？

english: Your ruination is at hand, [CT_NAME]! Your only chance of survival is to give mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT] what she wants!
chinese: 你的覆灭近在眼前，[CT_NAME]！你唯一的生路，就是交出强盛的[OUR_CIV_SHORT]想要的东西！

english: Very well. I hope that you won't come to regret this decision, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 好吧。但愿你不会为这个决定后悔，[CT_NAME]。

english: In the future you'd best remember who your friends are, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 往后你最好记清楚谁才是你的朋友，[CT_NAME]。

english: Once again you disappoint me, [CT_NAME]. You'd be advised to see that it doesn't happen again.
chinese: 你又一次让我失望了，[CT_NAME]。我劝你留意，别再有下次了。

english: Well that's not very nice, if you ask me.
chinese: 要我说，这可不太厚道。

english: Curses: foiled again!
chinese: 该死：又栽了！

english: You are arrogant, [CT_NAME]. Some day it will lead to your destruction.
chinese: 你太傲慢了，[CT_NAME]。总有一天这会招致你的覆灭。

english: Foolish stubborness will lead to your destruction, [CT_NAME].
chinese: 愚蠢的顽固会招致你的覆灭，[CT_NAME]。

english: Very well. On your head be it.
chinese: 好吧。后果由你自负。

english: I don't think you realize just who you're dealing with, [CT_NAME]. I suggest you reconsider, and quickly!
chinese: 我看你还没认清你在跟谁打交道，[CT_NAME]。我劝你重新考虑，快点！

english: You gamble with the lives of your people, [CT_NAME]. Are you ready to pay the price if you lose?
chinese: 你在拿你子民的性命做赌注，[CT_NAME]。若是输了，你准备好付出代价了吗？

english: Fine. Next time I won't ask so nicely!
chinese: 行。下回我可不会问得这么客气了！

english: You're playing with fire, [CT_NAME]. See that you don't get burned.
chinese: 你在玩火，[CT_NAME]。当心别烧着自己。

english: You'll regret this, you wretched creature!
chinese: 你会后悔的，你这可悲的东西！

english: You test my patience, [CT_NAME]!
chinese: 你在挑战我的耐心，[CT_NAME]！

english: Very well. I suggest that you start cranking out those soldiers, [CT_NAME]. You'll have need of them shortly.
chinese: 好吧。我劝你开始拼命造兵吧，[CT_NAME]。你很快就会用得上他们。

english: You should think more carefully before you anger your betters, [CT_NAME], for it can lead to bitter consequences.
chinese: 触怒你的尊长之前，你该多想想，[CT_NAME]，因为那会招致惨痛的后果。

english: Fool! Don't you know that I could crush you like a grape?
chinese: 蠢货！你难道不知道，我能像捏碎一颗葡萄一样捏碎你？

english: How dare you deny my extremely reasonable request! You'll regret this, I promise!
chinese: 你竟敢拒绝我这极其合理的请求！你会后悔的，我保证！

english: The bonds between our civilizations would be greatly strengthened if you converted to [OUR_STATE_RELIGION].
chinese: 你若皈依[OUR_STATE_RELIGION]，我们两大文明之间的纽带将大大加固。

english: Isn't it about time that you abandoned your foolish beliefs and converted to [OUR_STATE_RELIGION], [CT_NAME]?
chinese: 是不是也该抛弃你那愚蠢的信仰，皈依[OUR_STATE_RELIGION]了，[CT_NAME]？

english: You should consider converting to [OUR_STATE_RELIGION], [CT_NAME]. It is the one true path to salvation.
chinese: 你该考虑皈依[OUR_STATE_RELIGION]，[CT_NAME]。这是通往救赎的唯一正道。

english: I urge you to convert to [OUR_STATE_RELIGION], [CT_NAME]. Religious wars can be so unpleasant...
chinese: 我劝你皈依[OUR_STATE_RELIGION]，[CT_NAME]。宗教战争可是很不愉快的……

english: Our gods can beat your gods any day of the week, [CT_NAME]. Convert to [OUR_STATE_RELIGION] before it's too late!
chinese: 我们的神随时都能击败你们的神，[CT_NAME]。趁还来得及，皈依[OUR_STATE_RELIGION]吧！

english: [OUR_STATE_RELIGION] is mighty, [CT_NAME]. Convert now, before the heavens rain their displeasure upon you.
chinese: [OUR_STATE_RELIGION]无比强大，[CT_NAME]。立刻皈依，免得上苍降下祂的震怒。

english: The heavens demand that you join [OUR_STATE_RELIGION] immediately. Consider your answer carefully!
chinese: 上苍要求你立刻加入[OUR_STATE_RELIGION]。慎重考虑你的答复！

english: Abandon your heathenish ways and join [OUR_STATE_RELIGION], [CT_NAME]. Your people's survival depends on it!
chinese: 抛弃你那异教的行径，加入[OUR_STATE_RELIGION]吧，[CT_NAME]。你子民的存亡系于此举！

english: Discard your false religion and embrace [OUR_STATE_RELIGION], [CT_NAME]. If you wish to survive...
chinese: 抛弃你那伪信，拥抱[OUR_STATE_RELIGION]吧，[CT_NAME]。若你还想活命的话……

english: Very well. We know that this can be a sensitive matter.
chinese: 好吧。我们知道这可能是件敏感的事。

english: As you wish.
chinese: 随你所愿。

english: We shall speak of this again at a later time.
chinese: 此事我们改日再谈。

english: On your own head be it.
chinese: 后果由你自负。

english: You disappoint me. And you disappoint the heavens. Foolish.
chinese: 你让我失望。你也让上苍失望。愚蠢。

english: Very well. But remember, [CT_NAME], The wages of sin are death.
chinese: 好吧。但记住，[CT_NAME]，罪的代价乃是死。

english: So be it. I pray that your people do not suffer overmuch for your folly.
chinese: 那就随你吧。我祈祷你的子民不会为你的愚行受太多苦。

english: You mock the heavens at your peril, [CT_NAME]! I can but hope that you will see wisdom before it is too late.
chinese: 你亵慢上苍，是自寻死路，[CT_NAME]！我只盼你在为时已晚之前幡然醒悟。

english: I fear that your blasphemy will not go unpunished, [CT_NAME]. I'd invest in a lot of lightning rods if I were you.
chinese: 我担心你的亵渎不会不受惩罚，[CT_NAME]。若我是你，就多备些避雷针。

english: Please join us by adopting %s1.
chinese: 请采纳%s1，与我们同道。

english: All the cool civs are adopting %s1, [CT_NAME]. How about you?
chinese: 所有出色的文明都在采纳%s1，[CT_NAME]。你呢？

english: Have you considered adopting %s1? it will bring our two civilizations even closer together.
chinese: 你可曾考虑采纳%s1？这会让我们两大文明更加亲近。

english: I urge you to adopt %s1, [CT_NAME]. Your civilization will be the better for it.
chinese: 我劝你采纳%s1，[CT_NAME]。你的文明会因此更好。

english: %s1 is extremely useful, [CT_NAME]. [CT_CIV_SHORT] would do well to adopt it.
chinese: %s1极为有用，[CT_NAME]。[CT_CIV_SHORT]采纳它准没错。

english: Adopt %s1 - before it's too late!
chinese: 采纳%s1——趁还来得及！

english: As you will.
chinese: 随你所愿。

english: I suppose you know best.
chinese: 我想你自有主张。

english: On your head be it.
chinese: 后果由你自负。

english: Really? How foolish.
chinese: 是吗？真愚蠢。
